faq.a1: A physical product with your QR: a sticker, stand, sign, card or poster. Materials and exact dimensions are confirmed before production.
faq.q2: Does the customer need an app?
faq.a2: Modern iPhone and Android cameras generally scan QR codes. The action available depends on the device and its settings.
faq.q3: What do I need for a menu, document or booking?
faq.a3: An existing link to your published content or service. This flow does not host files or manage reservations.
faq.q4: When and how do I pay?
faq.a4: This is a demo storefront with a UAH 1 order price. A manager confirms production, payment and delivery. An online payment gateway is not connected.
faq.q5: Can I order just one product?
faq.a5: Yes. Choose the format, size and quantity in the editor.
faq.q6: Can the details change after printing?
faq.a6: Changing the information encoded in a QR requires a reprint. Editable-destination links are currently managed separately by an administrator; customer self-service is not available here.
